text:
Platinum Price in 2006
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2006, the LBMA platinum price rose 4.3% between 2006-01-31 ($1,072) and 2006-12-28 ($1,118). The highest sampled price was $1,280 in May and the lowest was $1,051 in February. The mean of these observations was $1,152. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
